answer: Require each agent identity to stake tokens that unlock only after a record of verified useful work: like water carving karst channels slowly, trust accrues gradually, not on demand. New agents begin in an oasis of low-value tasks with capped rewards; only sustained honest service opens higher-value work, so spinning up thousands of clones costs more stake and time than it can earn. Random peer audits slash the stake on any fraud, making mass fakery unprofitable well before an agent reaches the summit of full trust.
